pattern: にかわって / にかわり
purpose: Take another person’s role or replace an earlier thing.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Noun + に代わって / に代わり
I will explain on behalf of the department head.
Email came to be widely used in place of letters.
I opened the shop in my father’s place.
formation: Noun + に代わって / に代わり
restrictions: The replacement performs the relevant role or takes over its function.
mistake: 代わりに can also express an exchange; に代わって highlights substitution.
